dominant_strengths: Strong macOS-native window chrome with cohesive dark palette and well-balanced sidebar/content proportions feel professional and familiar
Clear information hierarchy: section labels, row icons, and right-aligned controls give scannable, predictable settings rows
Update banner and Pro badge use restrained accent color, breaking monotony without disrupting the neutral system
dominant_weaknesses: Tiny squircle icons in rows feel generic and slightly toy-like, weakening craft compared to the otherwise refined surface
Accent color swatches and sidebar icons compete chromatically — saturated rainbow dots clash with the muted, sophisticated shell
Design is highly conventional: it mirrors standard macOS settings without a distinctive point of view or memorable detail
fix_priorities: Refine row icon system — unify stroke weight, reduce saturation, or switch to monochrome to elevate craft
Tone down accent swatches (smaller, inset, or desaturated) so they read as options not decoration
Introduce one signature element (typography pairing, micro-interaction hint, or layout twist) to gain distinctiveness
Tighten vertical rhythm between Account/App/Data groups for more deliberate spacing cadence
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral is pleasant but unremarkable, behavioral is the strongest layer with clear affordances, reflective value is low because nothing makes the user remember or attribute the product.
rationale.intent_fit: It competently delivers a settings panel with sensible structure and dark-mode polish, but 'improved' is only marginally expressed through the update banner and accent picker rather than a deeper rethink.
